newsitem.title: USA: September aluminum orders up 16.9 percent - Spector.
newsitem.headline: September aluminum orders up 16.9 percent - Spector.

text.p: Aluminum mill product bookings in September rose 16.9 percent from September 1995, but the rate of new orders declined towards the end of the month, industry analyst Stewart Spector said.
"Excluding can sheet, bookings were at the best levels the industry experienced since 1994," Spector said in his latest Aluminum Industry Service newsletter.
With the sharp drop in LME ingot prices in recent weeks, mill product buyers were not anxious to order new metal into the decline.
The daily order rate in September, seasonally adjusted, averaged 66.4 million pounds, compared to an upwardly revised 61.6 million per day in August and 56.8 million in September 1995.

September can sheet releases were down 0.6 percent on the same month in 1995, but better than they were during the summer, suggesting that destocking of the higher priced sheet bought in 1995 has ended, Spector said.
